name: @binderly/pricing-display
description: Pure-logic FX-aware price display for Binderly: takes a price observation (amount + currency + observed date) plus a user's display preference, looks up the FX rate that was in effect on the observation date, converts, and returns formatted strings + structured ConvertedPrice objects. No IO, no DB, no async — safe to call from server (price-aggregate enrichment) and client (web/mobile card detail) alike.
